if (isHallMapId(mapId)) return false;
  const key = discoveryKeyOf(mapId); // AUDIT TESA II P6

name: AUDITWW-F1-the-carriage-guard
old: if (!immersiveTravelLoaded() || !Number.isFinite(mapId) || isHallMapId(mapId)) return false; // AUDIT WW F1: a zone hall's id is no Bay town's
new: if (!immersiveTravelLoaded() || !Number.isFinite(mapId)) return false; // AUDIT WW F1: a zone hall's id is no Bay town's

name: AUDITWW-F2-the-admission-unbounded
old: return isGateDay(day) && gateLaneOpen(gateLaneOf(day)) && nowMs >= t.openAt && nowMs < t.sealAt;
new: return isGateDay(day) && nowMs >= t.openAt && nowMs < t.sealAt;

name: AUDITWW-F2-the-hold-unbounded
old: return isGateDay(day) && gateLaneOpen(gateLaneOf(day)) && nowMs >= t.openAt && nowMs < t.wrathAt + GATE_COLLAPSE_MS;
new: return isGateDay(day) && nowMs >= t.openAt && nowMs < t.wrathAt + GATE_COLLAPSE_MS;

name: AUDITWW-F2-the-words-unbounded
old: export const gatePixelOk = (d, px, py) => gateNumberOk(d) && gateLanePixelOk(gateLaneWire(d), px, py);
new: export const gatePixelOk = (d, px, py) => Number.isSafeInteger(d) && d >= 0 && gateLanePixelOk(gateLaneWire(d), px, py);

name: AUDITWW-F3-the-spent-word-unbounded
old: if (m.k === 'spent') return gateNumberOk(m.d) ? { k: 'spent', d: m.d } : null;
new: if (m.k === 'spent') return Number.isSafeInteger(m.d) && m.d >= 0 ? { k: 'spent', d: m.d } : null;

new: say(RITE_TEXT.broken({ near: C.near, by: b.by, n: b.n }));

name: AUDITWW-F9-the-band-over-the-border
old: if (theatre === BAY_THEATRE ? !inBay(px, py) : !inWorldGrid(px, py) || theatreAt(px, py) !== theatre) continue; // WW1: a band keeps its own theatre - the Bay's on the Bay's map, as it always did; AUDIT WW F9: a province's in its province (a road by the border never puts its band over it - in Cyrodiil's open zone, or another province)
new: if (theatre === BAY_THEATRE ? !inBay(px, py) : inBay(px, py) || !inWorldGrid(px, py)) continue; // WW1: a band keeps its own theatre - the Bay's on the Bay's map, as it always did; AUDIT WW F9: a province's in its province (a road by the border never puts its band over it - in Cyrodiil's open zone, or another province)
